training_contract.ground_truth_policy: deterministic extraction from licensed evidence; no API or teacher output is ground truth
training_contract.blind_test_policy: sealed and forbidden until checkpoint selection is frozen and separately authorized

input_contract.local_measurement_boundary: published literature must remain published_literature_not_local_measurement unless a separately authenticated local instrument record is supplied

output_contract.answer_rule: ANSWER requires a non-empty evidence-bounded claim, SUPPORTED verdict, at least one evidence ID, and exact source provenance
output_contract.refuse_rule: REFUSE requires an empty claim, REFUSED verdict, empty evidence_ids, and preserved source provenance

runtime_contract.primary_x5_backend: CPU llama.cpp GGUF Q4_K_M one-shot/manual-load candidate

claim_boundary: This contract defines a manually selected, evidence-bounded ICMat model-bank candidate. It does not claim production integration, local experimental ground truth, BPU execution for this LLM, or replacement of the frozen competition services.
